_source: IISER Bhopal Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) Mass Spectrometry division
name: High-Resolution Quadrupole Time-of-Flight Mass Spectrometer (UHPLC-HRMS)
specs: Electrospray Ionization (ESI) and Atmospheric Pressure Chemical Ionization (APCI) sources
High mass accuracy (< 2 ppm) with UHPLC front-end separation and MS/MS fragmentation
Intact protein deconvolution workflow for monoclonal antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs)
useCases: Drug-to-Antibody Ratio (DAR) determination and site-specific peptide mapping for ADC therapeutics
Exact mass confirmation of novel fluorophores, peptides, and small-molecule drug candidates
bookingNotes: Samples must be pre-filtered (0.22 micron) with expected molecular weight range specified.
